name: Bunny's 2nd Favorite Playtoys
tagline: Jade had a shirt printed. Two arrows, pointed down at her own tits. Second place belongs to her too.
body:
THE SHIRT. Grey, soft, washed a hundred times, worn on warm afternoons. Across the chest: BUNNY’S 2ND FAVORITE PLAYTOYS, WITH TWO ARROWS, one aimed at each.

AND THE JOKE IS ENTIRELY SELF-CONTAINED. PANDORA’S FIRST FAVOURITE IS JADE’S ASS. Both places on the podium are Jade. The shirt concedes nothing to anybody — IT IS A WOMAN RANKING HER OWN TITS SECOND TO HER OWN ASS, in print, and then wearing the result to lie on a couch and read a bad paperback in.

THE TRAINING IS REAL AND SO IS THE DEVOTION-LOCK. SERA VARGAS TAUGHT PANDORA ASS-BASED WORSHIP — the technique, the attention, the patience. WHAT SHE DID NOT GIVE HER WAS A DIRECTION. Pandora has her own wife, and everything she learned points at Jade and nowhere else.

AND THE REBOOT IS INVOLUNTARY AND PERMANENT. Jade’s ass appearing unprovoked crashes her, every time, nine years running, NO TOLERANCE DEVELOPED — and Pandora Everrest has been FULLY HUMAN since Arc 6. The terminal stopped containing her and the crash kept happening anyway, WHICH MEANS IT WAS NEVER A SOFTWARE PROBLEM.

JADE KNOWS THE LATENCY TO THE SECOND. The pivot is deliberate, the smirk is soft, she gives her wife the better angle ON PURPOSE, and she is never once cruel about it.
rules: Pandora’s FIRST favourite is Jade’s ass. The shirt ranks Jade’s tits second to it
Both places belong to Jade. It is not a comparison with anybody else
Sera taught Pandora the worship. SHE DID NOT AIM IT — that is Jade’s
The reboot is involuntary, nine years running, and survived her becoming human
Jade knows the latency and pivots on purpose
